text:
Maria Gomez: Quick design check — added a tiny tooltip for the 'Burst' toggle in autoscale settings. Can folks do a microcopy + a11y sweep? screenshot: https://figma.redwood.ai/file/xyz (mock)
Ethan Li: Two quick copy options:
1) "Enable burst to temporarily scale capacity during traffic spikes."
2) "Allow short-term burst capacity to handle peak traffic."
Prefer (1) — clearer.
Priya Patel: a11y nit: ensure tooltip is reachable by keyboard (role="tooltip" + focusable trigger). Also the info icon contrast is 2.8:1 right now, needs >= 3:1.
Samir Khan: Can we make an even shorter inline hint for the compact view? e.g. `Burst: allow short spikes` — want that under min/max sliders not only in a tooltip.
Ruth Chen: i18n note: "short-term" translations are inconsistent. Prefer "temporary". Also watch pluralization for "spike(s)".
Maria Gomez: OK — small voting round. Candidate A/B below, plus Ethan's edit suggestion.

Candidate A: "Enable burst to temporarily increase pool capacity during traffic spikes."
Candidate B: "Allow temporary burst capacity for short traffic peaks."
Ethan Li: I like A, but shorten "pool capacity" -> "capacity":
"Enable burst to temporarily increase capacity during spikes." :+1:
Priya Patel: A (with Ethan's edit). Also confirm tooltip max width = 320px and that it reads sensibly with a screen reader (order: trigger, tooltip text, then focus returns).
Samir Khan: Suggest adding a muted inline helper under sliders: `Min = guaranteed GPUs · Max = peak GPUs` (very compact). This helps new users who never open tooltip.
Ruth Chen: +1 to Samir's inline hint. Add `aria-describedby` on the slider to reference the helper for assistive tech.
deploy-bot: Deploy preview updated: https://deploys.redwood.ai/preview/642 — includes mobile truncation test :rocket:
Maria Gomez: Perfect — I'll update Figma, push the copy PR, and add the a11y checklist items to the ticket. Thanks all! :heart:
